import math

# Recompute longest playlist total duration from detailed playlists
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [i['password'] for i in pw_list if i['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

# fetch all playlists in library (public + private)
api = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library

def fetch_all_playlists(is_public):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = api(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        all_items.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

public_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(True)
private_playlists = fetch_all_playlists(False)
pl_by_id = {p['playlist_id']: p for p in public_playlists+private_playlists}

max_entry=None
for pid in sorted(pl_by_id.keys()):
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds = sum([s.get('duration') or 0 for s in songs])
    minutes = total_seconds/60
    rounded = int(minutes + 0.5)  # nearest integer, halves up
    entry = {
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'title': pl.get('title'),
        'num_songs': len(songs),
        'total_seconds': total_seconds,
        'minutes': minutes,
        'rounded_minutes': rounded
    }
    if (max_entry is None) or (total_seconds > max_entry['total_seconds']):
        max_entry = entry

print('max_entry', max_entry)
print('answer_rounded_minutes', max_entry['rounded_minutes'])
